 Tacony-Palmyra Bridge closed to traffic after being struck by cargo ship
 By
 Laura Fay , 
 Joe Holden 
 Joe Holden 
 Joe Holden came home to join the CBS News Philadelphia team as a general assignment reporter in May, 2016. In August 2018 he became anchor of the weekend evening editions and Philly57.
 Read Full Bio 
 Joe Holden 
 Updated on: November 12, 2026 / 3:52 PM EST 
 / CBS Philadelphia
 Add CBS News on Google 
 The Tacony-Palmyra Bridge is closed to traffic Thursday afternoon after it was struck by a cargo ship, officials said. 
 The bridge that connects Philadelphia and Burlington County, New Jersey, was open for ships to pass through when a boat struck it around 1:15 p.m., according to the Delaware Bay Coast Guard.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Joe Holden (@josephbholden) 
 Crews are at the scene, and the bridge is staying open until they can assess the damage and make repairs. It's not clear when it will reopen to car and pedestrian traffic.
 No one was hurt, according to a Burlington County spokesperson.
